product.title: Front Office City — District A
product.summary: A 3D walk-around city where eight mission zones each hold a cap decision.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students steer an avatar through a stylised 3D city to eight sequential mission zones, opening each to make a decision on Bird Rights, the mid-level exception, trade exceptions or dead money, with legality checks and payroll and flexibility consequences, ending in a tier and claim code.

delivery.devices: browser with WebGL; needs a build step to run

product.technology: Vite + 3D world, with a serverless attempt-lock API

studentDataProfile.notes: An exam-integrity attempt lock keys records by class profile and needs durable storage in production. Descriptive only.

governance.maturityBasis: Substantial infrastructure — signed attempt locks, teacher strict-lock, audit history — with no automated tests behind it. Ambition outruns verification.

health.technicalBasis: No GitHub Pages deployment (404) and no confirmed live instance. Requires a build and a signed-key deployment to run.
knownBlockers: No deployment, so an instructor cannot run it today.
Attempt-lock infrastructure requires durable KV storage and is unverified end to end.

governance.notes: Despite the name, this is not a 'final' version of T201-M1-L1. It is a separate 3D product line that predates the T201 lessons, which appear to have superseded it for classroom use.

publicRelease.previewReason: 3D walk-around city with eight cap-decision mission zones. Real, unfinished, and the clearest signal of where BOW is heading.

provenance.evidence: M1-201-FINAL/README.md: '8 mission zones in linear unlock order'; src/data/missions.js includes 'Mission 2 - Bird Rights Call'. Only syntax, schema and TODO-audit scripts exist — no tests.
